name: Doki Doki Pretty League: Nekketsu Otome Seishunki
original_name: ドキドキプリティリーグ 熱血乙女青春記
source:
In this game you play a coach for an all-girl baseball team. The game plays like a managerial game where you have to keep track of the schedule, add practice time for the girls and play games to advance in the series. But to keep the team happy you must also make sure they have a good social life as well as a well thought out training regime.

[from [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/playstation/doki-doki-pretty-league-nekketsu-otome-seishunki]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你扮演一支女子棒球队的教练。这款游戏的玩法就像一款管理游戏，你必须跟踪日程安排，为女孩们增加练习时间，并玩游戏以在系列赛中晋级。但为了让团队保持快乐，你还必须确保他们拥有良好的社交生活以及经过深思熟虑的培训制度。

[来自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/playstation/doki-doki-pretty-league-nekketsu-otome-seishunki]MobyGames[/url]]
